# Shaffer Construction, Inc.

> Licensed C-10 electrical contractor specializing in EV charger installation, electrical panel upgrades, LED retrofit, and commercial electrical services throughout Los Angeles County and statewide California.

Shaffer Construction provides professional electrical services for residential and commercial properties. We are experts in electric vehicle charging infrastructure, from single home installations to multi-location commercial rollouts.

## Primary Services

- [Commercial EV Chargers](https://shaffercon.com/commercial-electric-vehicle-chargers): Enterprise-grade Level 2 and DC fast charging solutions for business fleets, retail properties, and multi-location facilities across California
- [Residential EV Chargers](https://shaffercon.com/residential-ev-charger): Home EV charging station installation with panel upgrades and load studies for Los Angeles homeowners
- [Electrical Load Studies](https://shaffercon.com/electrical-load-studies): Professional electrical capacity analysis, 7-30 day monitoring, and engineering documentation for EV infrastructure planning
- [LED Retrofit Services](https://shaffercon.com/led-retrofit-services): Energy-efficient lighting upgrades for commercial facilities with utility rebate assistance, 50-70% energy savings
- [Statewide Facilities Maintenance](https://shaffercon.com/statewide-facilities-maintenance): 24/7 emergency electrical repairs and preventive maintenance programs for multi-location facilities across California

## Typical Customer Questions

**Do I need to upgrade my electrical panel for an EV charger?**
Approximately 20% of California homes require panel upgrades. We provide free load studies to assess your current capacity. Most modern 200-amp panels can support Level 2 charging without upgrades.

**What's the difference between Level 2 and DC Fast Charging?**
Level 2 chargers use 240V AC power and add 12-40 miles of range per hour, ideal for home and workplace charging. DC Fast Chargers deliver 25-350 kW and can add 250 miles in 30 minutes, typically used for commercial fleet operations and public charging corridors.

**How long does installation take?**
Residential installations typically take 3-5 hours. Timeline from consultation to completion is 4-6 weeks including permits (1-2 weeks), any electrical upgrades (1-2 weeks), and final installation with inspection (3-5 days).

**Do you serve commercial properties outside Los Angeles?**
Yes, we provide statewide California coverage for multi-location commercial projects including EV charging rollouts, facilities maintenance, and LED retrofit programs.
